Security-list Store starts upstream server.NewServer directly with token Authorization, loopback TCP nats.Connect and file-backed JetStream, one replica. It does not use natscell/in-process protocol and does not establish quorum/restart/cloud resilience.

The real OCI SDK targets httptest loopback HTTP and signs requests with a generated RSA configuration provider. Handler checks nonempty Authorization only, not signature correctness. OCI records are synthetic, with no live OCI/instance-principal acceptance. SDK default HTTP transport is environment-sensitive; no runtime environment or network containment was inspected.

All placement authority, store, fleet, host and artifact dependencies are synthetic. Controller reconstruction retains the same maps/slices. No signed log commit, actual OCI request, admitted host session, durable CAS, runtime/process/mount/cgroup or force-detach execution is established. ManagedMountPath is pure path construction.

Failing-placement root observes the later map CAS callback before its seat-key collision can reject persistence; it proves only attempted later progress in source. Changed-payload-only table case is held by the earlier multi-region guard, not uniquely the payload comparison.

growVolume may emit an incidental resize decision through the process-local correlation table and default recorder/structured-log fallback. GrowsUndersized does not install or query a journal, assert the logging effect, or gain integration credit from it.
All original safety assertions remain retained; no repository/source/ledger changes, deletion, count promotion, qualification, retirement or refactor-completion credit.
